name: Build ARM64 overlay

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Install Android SDK/NDK
        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v4
        with:
          packages: platform-tools

      - name: Install NDK and CMake
        run: |
          sdkmanager "platform-tools"
          sdkmanager "platforms;android-35"
          sdkmanager "ndk;27.2.12479018"
          sdkmanager "cmake;3.22.1"

      - name: Fetch Dear ImGui
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/ocornut/imgui.git third_party/imgui

      - name: Fetch Android native-window creator
        run: |
          mkdir -p include
          curl -L --fail --retry 3 \
            https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mohamad-aljeiawi/android-native-window-symbol-patcher/main/a_native_window_creator.h \
            -o include/a_native_window_creator.h

      - name: Provide native-window creator globals
        run: |
          cat > src/a_native_window_creator.cpp <<'EOF'
          #include <cstddef>
          #include "a_native_window_creator.h"

          namespace android::anative_window_creator::detail::compat {
          size_t SystemVersion = 0;
          }
          EOF

      - name: Build Stockfish ARM64
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish.git stockfish

          export ANDROID_NDK="$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/ndk/27.2.12479018"
          export PATH="$ANDROID_NDK/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin:$PATH"

          which aarch64-linux-android21-clang++

          cd stockfish/src
          make -j2 build ARCH=armv8 COMP=ndk

          cp stockfish /tmp/stockfish-android-arm64

      - name: Configure
        run: |
          export ANDROID_NDK_HOME="$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/ndk/27.2.12479018"

          cmake -S . -B build \
            -G Ninja \
            -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE="$ANDROID_NDK_HOME/build/cmake/android.toolchain.cmake" \
            -DANDROID_ABI=arm64-v8a \
            -DANDROID_PLATFORM=android-35 \
            -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
            -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=20 \
            -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED=ON \
            -DCMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS=ON

      - name: Build
        run: |
          cmake --build build --parallel

      - name: Package
        run: |
          mkdir -p artifact
          cp build/chess-analyzer-overlay artifact/chess-analyzer-overlay

          if [ -f /tmp/stockfish-android-arm64 ]; then
            cp /tmp/stockfish-android-arm64 artifact/stockfish-android-arm64
          fi

          chmod 755 artifact/chess-analyzer-overlay
          cp README.md artifact/README.md

          tar -czf chess-analyzer-overlay-arm64.tar.gz -C artifact .

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: chess-analyzer-overlay-arm64
          path: chess-analyzer-overlay-arm64.tar.gz
